name: AmwalPay for BA Booking
author: amwalpay

sections.description:
Accept Secure Payments with AmwalPay for BA Booking

AmwalPay for BA Booking allows merchants to accept secure online payments via credit/debit cards and digital wallets through the Amwal Payment Gateway.

Key Features

✅ Seamless 3D Secure (3DS) Authentication
✅ PCI-DSS Compliant & Highly Secure Transactions
✅ Fast Settlements & High Payment Success Rates
✅ Tokenization for Secure Card Storage
✅ Mobile-First Checkout Experience

With AmwalPay, businesses can process transactions efficiently while providing customers with a smooth and secure checkout experience.

Learn More: AmwalPay Official Website

Configuration

To enable AmwalPay, you need the following credentials from AmwalPay:
🔹 Merchant ID
🔹 Terminal ID
🔹 Secret Key

Enter these credentials under BA Booking > Settings > Payments > AmwalPay to start processing payments.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress Admin Dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Search for “AmwalPay for BA Booking”.
  4. Click Install Now, then Activate the plugin.
  5. Go to BA Booking > Settings > Payments and configure AmwalPay Settings.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin as a .zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the .zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin and configure the settings under BA Booking > Settings > Payments.
sections.faq:
1. How do I get AmwalPay API credentials?

Sign up at AmwalPay, and our sales team will contact you. Once the contract is signed, we will provide your Merchant ID, Terminal ID, and Secure Key.

2. Is AmwalPay secure?

Yes, AmwalPay is PCI-DSS compliant and supports 3D Secure authentication for safe transactions.

3. What payment methods does AmwalPay support?

AmwalPay supports credit/debit cards and digital wallets.

4. Does this plugin support test mode?

Yes, you can enable sandbox mode using the UAT API for testing before going live.
